definitions.gloss: flatly, without listening to the other side
definitions.explanation: Scolding, refusing, or condemning someone from the start without hearing what they have to say. Used mostly as {頭|あたま}ごなしに before verbs such as {叱|しか}る, {怒|おこ}る and {否定|ひてい}する.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}ごなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叱|しか}らないで→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頭|あたま}ごなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{否定|ひてい}した→否定する：06063_hiteisuru⟧。
examples.english: My father dismissed my opinion out of hand.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頭|あたま}ごなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧あげた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Before scolding a child outright, it's better to hear their reasons first.

notes:
Always critical of the one who does it. The image is of pushing someone down from the head.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頭|あたま}ごなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叱|しか}る→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧: to scold without listening
- {頭|あたま}ごなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{否定|ひてい}する→否定する：06063_hiteisuru⟧: to reject out of hand
- {頭|あたま}ごなし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: a high-handed order

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一方的|いっぽうてき}→一方的：17695_ippouteki⟧: one-sided — broader, any act that ignores the other party
- ⟦{決|き}めつける→決めつける：13267_kimetsukeru⟧: to jump to a conclusion about someone
